## WorkerThreadGatewayClient.request() method

Make an RPC request to the server.

**Signature:**

```typescript
request(method: string, params: unknown[], _wait?: boolean, _others?: Record<string, unknown>, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<unknown>;
```
